versions.changelog: Publish from public openclaw-knowledge-skills repo; clarify generic path setup, require explicit COMPILE_INBOX_DIR, fail fast on missing inbox, and remove private path assumptions.
Clarify generic install safety: COMPILE_INBOX_DIR must be explicitly configured and existing; precheck fails fast instead of silently creating or scanning the wrong inbox.
Initial release: compile raw markdown notes into structured transit documents with archive links, checkpoints, and audit checks.
